_doc: File-state handoff channel for isolated sub-agents (SDD benchmark 5.2.1). The orchestrator writes a task here; an isolated sub-agent (e.g. sdd-reviewer, read-only w.r.t. implementation) appends its verdict to `messages` and never edits implementation code directly. `phase` mirrors .sdd/spec-lock.json (idle | spec | test-red | impl-green | review). Set `retryCount` on each failed attempt; when it reaches `maxTaskRetries`, roll back the spec's implementation files and halt.
